cases.exposure_context_quote: The patient drank almost 50 mL dichlorvos impulsively due to family conflict with her daughter-in-law and agitation on March 27, 2023.
cases.agent_quote: The patient drank almost 50 mL dichlorvos impulsively due to family conflict with her daughter-in-law and agitation on March 27, 2023.
cases.circumstance: impulsive ingestion in a suicide attempt due to family conflict; urgently sent to local hospital for gastric lavage

symptoms.quote: Symptoms: Epigastric pain • mental apathy • vomiting
Symptoms: Epigastric pain • mental apathy • vomiting
Over the next 3 months, she presented with intermittent nausea, vomiting, epigastric pain, and mental apathy, and was readmitted.
The patient could not eat or drink water.

labs.name: white blood count
labs.quote: Laboratory test results showed white blood count of 4.54×109/L

labs.name: total protein
labs.quote: low total protein level of 53.5 g/L

labs.name: C-reactive protein
labs.quote: high C-reactive protein level of 10.78 mg/L

labs.name: erythrocyte sedimentation rate
labs.quote: high erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 25 mm/h

treatment.name: gastric lavage and detoxification
treatment.quote: She improved after being urgently sent to local hospital for gastric lavage and detoxification.

treatment.name: omeprazole (proton pump inhibitor)
treatment.quote: The use of a proton pump inhibitor (omeprazole) to inhibit gastric acid secretion

treatment.name: fluid/electrolyte maintenance (potassium and sodium supplementation)
treatment.quote: the maintenance of water-electrolyte balance (supplementing fluid with potassium and sodium) improved the patient’s symptoms.

treatment.name: gastrojejunostomy, Braun anastomosis, nasojejunal feeding tube placement
treatment.quote: Gastrojejunostomy, Braun anastomosis, and nasojejunal feeding tube placement were selected for the surgical procedure.

treatment.name: cholecystectomy, choledochotomy, intraoperative choledochoscopy, basket stone extraction, primary suture of common bile duct
treatment.quote: Meanwhile, cholecystectomy, choledochotomy, intraoperative choledochoscopy examination, basket stone extraction, and primary suture of the common bile duct were performed for biliary calculi.

cases.outcome: recovered; discharged 9 days after surgery, well at 2-month (66-day) follow-up
cases.outcome_quote: The patient recovered and was discharged 9 days after surgery. At the 66-day postoperative follow-up, the patient had a good appetite, smooth eating, and no nausea, vomiting, acid regurgitation, abdominal pain, abdominal distension, jaundice, or other discomfort.
cases.sequelae: pyloric obstruction due to dichlorvos-induced corrosive scarring (persisted ~3 months post-ingestion); transient mental apathy possibly related to CNS sequelae of dichlorvos poisoning
cases.notes: Suicide attempt (per Introduction: 'dichlorvos-induced pyloric obstruction due to attempted suicide'). Acute poisoning phase managed at local hospital; this admission was for delayed pyloric obstruction plus coexisting cholelithiasis/choledocholithiasis. BMI 17.3 kg/m2; history of hypertension.
